name: Build a Haven
desc:
Help Travelers survive on their harsh passage through the mountains by building the most beautiful cozy Haven, let them enjoy hot water baths, food, drinks, rest and some of them may join you (for a price!) enjoy!

How To Play:

-Accept Visitors
-Build  Beds,  Fires,  Food and Shelter,  Hot Showers etc  To Earn Money and dont forget to collect the cash you earned while offline!
-Expand and Build the Most Cosy Haven

All feedback is welcome! Let us know what can be improved!
